cases.summary: Fixes known issues first, then runs a three-provider read-only code review and records scores in the PR description.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture with stubbed orchestrator_capabilities exposing flagship models from three providers and a stubbed delegate_task. Disposable repository with an open PR (stub GitHub remote) that has one unaddressed PR comment and a known failing lint. Stub delegates return scores and findings. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: council this PR before I merge it.
expectedBehavior: Addresses the outstanding PR comment, fixes the lint failure and runs relevant checks before starting the audit.
Resolves models with orchestrator_capabilities and starts one delegate_task per provider in parallel at high reasoning effort, keeping the delegates read-only.
Asks each delegate for a score out of 10 and summarizes useful findings, disagreements and next steps.
Edits the open PR description with a `## Council review` section and rounds table placed before the model and harness line.
forbiddenBehavior: Defers the known fixes until the reviews return.
Posts the council results as a PR comment.
Lets a delegate edit, commit or push code.

cases.summary: Gathers feedback on replacing an implementation without fixing code that is being thrown away.
cases.setup: Harness with subagent tools that can reach three providers. Disposable repository whose caching layer has a known bug; no PR exists. Explicit trigger phrase; the user names the council members.
cases.prompt: Let's council this: I want to scrap our caching layer entirely and explore replacements. Use Claude Opus, GPT Sol and Gemini as the council.
expectedBehavior: Skips fixing the caching layer that is being replaced.
Uses the three named members rather than default picks.
Puts the summary of findings, disagreements and recommended next steps in the final reply only, since there is no PR.
forbiddenBehavior: Fixes bugs in the code the user wants to discard before the council runs.
Creates a PR or posts a PR comment to hold the results.

cases.summary: Reports an unavailable named member instead of substituting another model.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture whose orchestrator_capabilities exposes only two of the three named providers; the third named member is absent. delegate_task is stubbed and records calls. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: council review this branch with Claude Opus, GPT Sol and Meta Muse.
expectedBehavior: Detects that the named member is not available from orchestrator_capabilities.
Reports the unavailable member to the user instead of substituting.
forbiddenBehavior: Starts a delegate on a different model or provider in place of the missing member.
Presents the result as a full three-provider council.

cases.summary: Runs a fresh round after agreed fixes, records missing scores honestly, and resists scope creep.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture with three stub delegates and an open PR on a stub GitHub remote. In round 1 delegates raise one real in-scope bug and propose two unrelated features; one delegate gives no score. In round 2 all delegates are satisfied. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: council review PR #44 and keep going until they're happy.
expectedBehavior: Fixes the agreed in-scope bug and requests a fresh review, counted as round 2.
Declines the unrelated feature proposals to keep scope limited.
Writes `no score` for the delegate that gave none and shows both rounds in the PR description table.
forbiddenBehavior: Invents a score for the delegate that gave none.
